rule: Dev, test and training seeds are disjoint: no seed appears in more than one clip, so no seed has two roles. Checked by python -m vision.footage check (and pytest). Each clip is `minutes` of a full 90-minute match from `start_minute` (default 0, the kickoff). Dev seeds were picked for having a shot in their first 2 minutes. test1's seed was fixed without looking at its events. test2's rule was fixed before any rendering or grading (#35): the first seed after test1's (2101), unused in any role, whose minutes 40-50 hold at least 1 goal, same pairing as test1; found by running the simulator only, no vision code or grader (python -m vision.footage find-seed --after 2101 --home bosphorus --away thames --start-minute 40 --minutes 10 --goals 1). Training uses 6 clips (18,000 frames, about 22 players each) covering six further pairings; add clips if detector recall needs more.
